319 likes, 4 comments - 91mobiles on October 9, 2026: "At the Snapdragon event at IMC 2026 today, Qualcomm announced its newest flagship chips for India: Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 and 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6.

iQOO, Motorola and Xiaomi will be among the first OEMs to launch devices with the new Snapdragon processors in India. The iQOO 16, Motorola Signature 27 and Xiaomi 18 Pro are confirmed to launch in India soon.

Which Qualcomm-powered flagship are you waiting for? Let us know in the comments.

#IMC2026 #Qualcomm #iQOO #Motorola #Xiaomi".
